formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R4 — Fixed-R1 Soft-Matching Robustness, Progress-Granularity Perturbation, Target/Stratum Aggregation Duality, Caliper-Edge Inclusion Stress, Fresh-Batch/Method/Composition Leave-Out Transport, Negative-Control Stability & Structural-Attenuation Robustness Stress Test

scope.purpose: stress the already-observed R3 attenuation without reopening structural candidate selection

fixed_geometry.distance: 2x2 action-opportunity TV distance in action-mass units

perturbation_family.aggregation: equal progress-stratum weight within solve after target averaging

perturbation_family.expected_boundary: equivalent to exact-table matching because action-mass distance is integer-valued

fresh: leave each P11 acquisition batch out one at a time
each of four prebalanced sampling cells
legacy: leave each historical acquisition cohort out one at a time where cohort labels exist

fixed_readouts.primary_variant_metric: solve-level residual mean under each perturbation

adjudication.robust: BASE reproduction passes; at least 3 of Q4/Q6/Q10/Q5_STRATUM_EQUAL have adequate support and meet attenuation threshold in fresh; legacy has at least 3 analogous attenuated variants; no fresh leave-one-batch-out adequate-support variant exceeds parent magnitude
adjudication.fragile: otherwise, if two or more adequate-support fresh perturbations exceed half-parent magnitude or change attenuation conclusion
adjudication.exact_edge_note: Q5_EDGE_EXCLUDED is a support diagnostic only and cannot by itself make the verdict fragile because it intentionally collapses to the exact sparse regime

negative_control.construction: same deterministic rotated-lb-label control as R3 under BASE and Q4/Q6/Q10 perturbations
negative_control.purpose: assess whether attenuation pattern is generically induced by smoothing across progress partitions

inference_boundary: R4 is post-result robustness analysis, not independent confirmation.
R1 is fixed and never reselected.
Subgroup and leave-out analyses are robustness diagnostics, not new discovery surfaces.
Attenuation stability supports descriptive structural explanation only.
No causal or cognitive mechanism promotion.
